### 🚀 What's New in v2.22.29

* **GitHub Developer Console Security Hardening**: Complete security architecture overhaul ensuring zero hardcoded or baked-in GitHub tokens/PATs in the Android APK. Write access requires authenticated developer mode with runtime-only token entry and immediate token purging upon logout.
* **Chronological Announcements & Smart Chat Ordering**: Resolved message reversal and sorting issues so announcements strictly appear oldest-to-newest with the newest message at the bottom. Includes smart auto-scroll when at the bottom and an interactive "New announcement" floating chip indicator when reading older messages.
* **Vivo & iQOO Force 90/120Hz Stability & Crash Shield**: Introduced `DisplayRefreshRateManager` with device fingerprint heuristics, strict resolution-matching display mode filtering, and comprehensive exception shielding to completely eliminate crashes on Vivo/iQOO devices across Android 11 to 16.
* **Production APK Security Hardening**: Ensured internal debug/crash activities are unexported, reinforced ProGuard/R8 obfuscation rules, and stripped sensitive logging.
* **Zero-Cache Real-Time Announcements**: Instantaneous real-time announcement delivery using direct GitHub Contents API with zero CDN cache delay.
